description: Major mudslide and boulder fall blocked both lanes near Sonapur tunnel. Clearance operations ongoing.
Massive erosion along Teesta River bank swept away 40m road section. NH-10 completely closed; traffic diverted to NH-717A Lava-Reshi.
River Barak flowing 1.2m above danger mark. Submerged culverts between Badarpur and Silchar.
Waterlogging and soft soil mud creep on hairpin bends. Heavy trucks restricted; light vehicles cautionary only.
Scouring observed around pier #3 due to surging flash flood currents. Weight limit reduced to 8 tonnes.
Snowmelt combined with heavy rain triggered scree avalanche. Pass impassable for all standard logistics convoys.
Fallen eucalyptus trees and debris clearance in progress by BRO unit. Single lane opened under escort.
